grade9.population: Fully participating students in matched, publicly reportable four-board Toronto secondary schools; not all city pupils

nonparticipation_diagnostic.target: Same usable schools only; registered Grade9 or first-time-eligible OSSLT cohort
nonparticipation_diagnostic.assumption: Every non/partially participating eligible student has a well-defined binary potential outcome under completion of the same assessment; observed fully participating outcomes are held fixed. No missing-at-random assumption.
nonparticipation_diagnostic.excluded: Unmatched/privacy-suppressed schools and Grade9 nonregistered pupils. OSSLT exempt counts are not added to E.
nonparticipation_diagnostic.per_school_checks: Y <= P <= E; Grade9 E=P+cntNoData; OSSLT E=P+Absent+Deferred+OSSLC+InsufficientEvidence
